ios.desc:
Coin Wallet — one secure crypto wallet for all your cryptocurrency. Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Solana, Litecoin, Monero and 2,000+ more. Buy, send, swap and manage your assets with full privacy and zero registration required.
 
Multi-Currency Wallet
Manage all your crypto in one place across 22 major blockchain networks:
Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, GRAM, TRON, Cardano, XRP, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Optimism, Base, Sui, Sonic, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Monero, Stellar, Bitcoin Cash, Ethereum Classic, Dash, Kaspa.
Also supports 2,000+ tokens including USDT, USDC, SHIB, PEPE, DAI, LINK, UNI, MATIC and more — ERC20, BEP20, SPL, TRC20, ARC20, Jettons and other standards.
 
Self-Custodial Wallet
Your private keys are stored only on your device and never shared with anyone. Also known as a non-custodial wallet.
 
Trusted Since 2015
Coin Wallet has been on the market since 2015, serving millions of users worldwide. Fully open-source and transparent.
 
Buy Crypto Instantly
Buy Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and hundreds of other cryptocurrencies directly in the app. Pay with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, SEPA Instant, Revolut Pay, Open Banking, PIX, SPEI, bank transfer and more — fast, simple and secure. No KYC options available.
 
Send, Receive & Swap
Send and receive any supported cryptocurrency instantly. Swap between hundreds of assets directly in the app — Bitcoin to USDT, Litecoin to Monero and more, privately and instantly. No KYC options available.
 
Staking
Put your crypto to work and earn rewards — directly in the app, with full control over your assets.
 
Security & Privacy
Your private keys are stored only on your device — no server, no third party ever has access. AES-256 encryption, BIP39 passphrase, PIN or biometric login, and hardware 2FA via YubiKey keep your funds safe. Full Tor and VPN support for complete anonymity. No registration, no logging, no trackers.
 
Web3 & DApps
Connect to thousands of decentralized apps and DeFi protocols via built-in browser and WalletConnect.
 
Multi-Language Support
Coin Wallet is available in 30 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Ukrainian, Persian, Thai, Polish, Dutch, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Swedish, Norwegian, Croatian, Serbian, Bosnian, Filipino, Hebrew, Khmer, Italian.
 
24/7 Support
Our dedicated support team is ready to assist you with any question. Extensive help articles and guides avail
